main_measure.name: t of the slope of the demeaned 3-bar forward return on the forecast (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with a positive supporting check; reject if slope t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual 3-bar move of grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: Minimum count not reached: 91 grid bars with forecast > 0 (minimum 300) and 208 grid bars in total (minimum 1000).
reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken on the same non-overlapping grid pooled over all its windows, grid bars without a full 3-bar forward return in their window are dropped, the slope t is the ordinary OLS t on the pooled grid, and the plan's 'inconclusive with too few bars' is reported as 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
